prd.overview: 애옹 작업, 프로젝트 상태, 문서/릴리즈를 한곳에서 관리하기 위한 개인 운영 콘솔
goals: Create a Manyfast-style planning document from the existing implementation.
Keep IA, specifications, architecture, and GitHub evidence traceable.
Support canvas-based project development and AI agent handoff.

targetUsers.name: Project operator
targetUsers.description: Uses the ops console to understand, plan, and manage projects.

targetUsers.name: Developer / AI agent
targetUsers.description: Uses evidence-backed specs and architecture to safely modify code.

scenarios: Analyze an existing GitHub repo into planning artifacts.
Edit IA/specs on a Figma-style canvas.
Export implementation briefs for humans or agents.
risks: GitHub analysis may miss runtime-only behavior.
Route-only IA can under-represent product intent until specs are reviewed.
openQuestions: Which generated specs should become implementation tasks first?
Which AI suggestions should require explicit approval?

requirements.title: Product navigation and page structure
requirements.description: Manyfast-style IA should explain how users move through the product pages.

requirements.title: Feature specification directory
requirements.description: Requirements, features, and detailed specifications should be traceable to IA pages.

requirements.title: Evidence-backed system architecture
requirements.description: API, service, storage, jobs, auth, and deployment boundaries should be visible with code evidence.

requirements.title: GitHub evidence and implementation traceability
requirements.description: Planning artifacts should link back to yongchane/Portfolio files, imports, docs, and API routes.

features.title: IA page hierarchy
features.description: Render product pages as depth-based IA items linked to specs and evidence.

features.title: Specification directory
features.description: Keep Requirement -> Feature -> Specification relationships separate from canvas layout.

features.title: Architecture graph
features.description: Show implementation architecture as a graph while preserving code evidence.
